# Mondo Creations, LLC

> Full-service design & fabrication studio in Oxnard, California (est. 2016). Large-scale models, props, sculptures, exhibits, signage and custom builds for film & TV, brand activations, advertising, events, retail and prototyping.

- Home: https://mondocreations.com/

- Contact (quote request): https://mondocreations.com/contact/

## Company
- Location: 3000 Paseo Mercado, Ste 107, Oxnard, CA 93036, USA
- Phone: 805-500-8059
- Email: sales@mondocreations.com

## Services
Sculpture fabrication, film & TV set/prop fabrication, brand activation builds, advertising props and oversized product replicas, architectural elements and ornamentation, events & exhibits fabrication, prototypes & mockups, retail storefronts and installations.

## In-house capabilities
3D scanning, 3D printing, large-scale 5-axis CNC machining, pattern & mold fabrication, resin casting, vacuum forming, fiberglass layups, foam sculpture, woodwork & metalwork, paint & finishing.

## Selected clients
Marvel, HBO, Netflix, Universal Studios, Nickelodeon, BBC, Disneyland, Pixar, Laika, Fortnite (Epic Games), Blizzard Entertainment, SEGA, Final Fantasy XIV (Square Enix), Procter & Gamble, Westfield.
